scheduler: Unchanged revision-2 test-only task group: at most two synthetic cases in flight, admitting one after each completion. One Swift Testing test at a time and --jobs 4 for compilation. Full 16/48 seeded cases plus the one shared fixed multi-span regression case per split; canonical record order retained.
seedDerivation: First 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256("ww-m2-fixture|v1|M2-RENDER-001|<split>|<index>"). Calibration uses "calibration", original holdout "holdout", revisions 2 and 3 use "holdout-2" and "holdout-3"; revision 4 exclusively uses "holdout-4" for indices 0..47. All 208 seeded identities are unique and pairwise disjoint, checked by RenderFreezeTests. The one fixed multi-span regression case is shared and not held out.

generator.case: One group, one 6-channel occurrence on one affine epoch; stratum = index mod 8.
generator.tones: Channel c: amplitude 0.5 at fraction r_c * (1 - 0.02 u) of lower Nyquist; r=[0.02,0.15,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.8], seeded phase.
generator.stopband: When 0.98 * (Fin/(a Fout)) > 1.01, six tones between output Nyquist and 0.98 input Nyquist (normalised).
generator.landmarks: 0.9-amplitude seeded-sign impulse at N/8 on every channel, and at N/4 + c*N/12 on channel c only.
generator.inactive: Channel index mod 6 carries -1 dBFS seeded uniform noise; all other channels exact zero.
generator.multiSpan: One unchanged fixed MixedGroup case per split (kink, gap, unsupported epoch, 44.1/48 kHz occurrences), with 12 landmarks and two skew pairs. The same multi-span case appears in all splits as disclosed regression coverage; it is not held out.

truth: The generator's WWTimeMap forward (alignedTime) and inverse (sourceFrame), not the render plan. Tone truth uses the exact inverse at hull ends and linear interpolation within an affine segment.
measurement: Unchanged from m2-freeze-render: steady frames with every tap in span; least-squares gain/phase/residual vs exact tone, parabolic landmark peak within four frames of truth with sign, common-impulse and phase-derived skew, inactive peak in dBFS. NaN or missing evidence fails. Canonical records sort by (caseIndex, kind, channel, encoded JSON).

holdout.enable: Only via python3 -B scripts/render-cpu-sampler.py holdout <new outside-repo evidence directory> on a clean freeze-containing commit; WW_M2_RENDER_4_HOLDOUT=1 swift test --jobs 4 --no-parallel --filter holdoutSplitMeetsEveryFrozenGate

renderer.recipe: m2Candidate: Kaiser-windowed sinc, halfWidth 32 taps per side, passband edge 0.8, stopband edge 1.0, beta 9.6, 2048 table phases, chunk 4096 output frames, maximum decimation 64

cpuTelemetry.calibrationProof: docs/m2/evidence/ww-018/calibration-rev4-{12,13}-*.{tsv,json,log,txt}; both runs used exactly this runner SHA, each passed 466 records with complete <=1-second coverage and <400% whole-tree CPU before the revision-4 freeze was committed.
cpuTelemetry.sampler: macOS libproc proc_listchildpids follows the swift-test PID and observed descendants by PPID ancestry across process groups. Every 0.1 seconds, proc_pidinfo returns a process-identity start time and cumulative task user+system CPU Mach ticks for each PID; mach_timebase_info converts to nanoseconds. Per-PID window CPU is the tick delta divided by the monotonic-nanosecond window; sum across all live descendants for the whole-tree peak. Include an initially seen PID's entire CPU lifetime; retain process identities across reparenting. Record each snapshot's monotonic beginning and end and fail closed if next end minus previous beginning exceeds one second, launch/exit coverage exceeds one second, any process query fails, a PID returns after an unobserved interval, or no SwiftPM helper is observed. Strictly <400% whole tree is PASS; exactly 400% or higher is FAIL. Missing coverage is INCOMPLETE. No rerun.

familyPeakEvidence: Reuse 38.5 MiB ru_maxrss and 198632-byte renderer working set from docs/m2/evidence/ww-018/holdout-timing.txt (original frozen source tree 94604633d6464391ade116b363f8874675381bf5); do not describe it as a new revision-4 measurement.
